    Profile

    Eulalia is a shrine maiden protecting the Great Forest of Zuka. She has great skill with handling Magil and her power to talk to spirits makes her one of the most powerful in Sephira. She acts strict as a shrine maiden, but towards friends she loves to show her kindness and innocence.

    Origin: Gula Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 151cm
    Weight: 39kg
    Birthday: Feb 12
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Emmel & fun things
    Hobbies: To sing out loud in nature
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 春野杏
